## Trellis: Episode Publish (YouTube)

Account-aware Episode publisher. The payload must include `youtube_account_id`. Video upload is delegated to E11, which resolves the selected Trellis credential and performs a resumable YouTube upload.

### Setup
1. Import and activate E11-youtube-account-upload first.
2. Replace `REPLACE_WITH_E11_WORKFLOW_ID` on the YouTube Upload node with E11's workflow ID.
3. Map all Supabase nodes to the Hub service-role credential.
4. Keep the first upload private while validating the channel destination.

Google tokens and client secrets stay in Trellis; this workflow must not contain a static YouTube credential.
